title: Masks n Mane
location: 2828 Kingsway Dr #3, Oakville, ON L6J 7M2, Canada
desc:
What if your Sunday plans were simply... getting taken care of?

Introducing MASKS & MANE hosted by @the.ghee.mama.productions, @skin9studio and @gistarallure - a beauty + self-care social created around all the little things we love doing, except this time, we've planned the whole afternoon for you.

Come in, settle down and start with a guided facial ritual by Skin 9 Studio - you will he taught and made to do double cleanse, enzyme mask, facial massage, mask and aftercare.

Wanna fix your hair after the facial? Want to get side braids, curls? You can get your little hair refresh with GistarAllure, choosing from a curated menu of hairstyles.

And in between? Make yourself a charm bracelet or keychain. Take cute photobooth pictures. Sip your coffee or matcha. Have your curated food box and charcuterie cup.

Mingle, talk, take pictures... or just sit and enjoy not having anywhere else to be.

And yes, you'll leave with a gua sha + face roller too.
